India
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in New Delhi, India.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Budapest
Regular biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Budapest
Service/Official biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Budapest
Diplomatic biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Budapest
Citizens of the Republic of Indiaare required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
